system.name: Ouroboros
system.one_liner: a wafer-scale SRAM computing-in-memory architecture with token-grained pipelining for LLM inference

components.name: Die
components.role: one of 9x7 homogeneous dies (23mm x 30mm) stitched together on the wafer, containing a 13x17 grid of CIM cores

components.name: Inter-Wafer Interface
components.role: optical Ethernet port enabling multi-wafer scaling beyond a single wafer's capacity

components.name: CIM
components.role: one of the 13x17 grid of compute-in-memory cores interconnected in a high-bandwidth mesh network within a die

components.name: Control Unit
components.role: manages sync, KV control, address generation and pipeline control for a CIM core

components.name: Sync. Reg.
components.role: synchronization register within the control unit

components.name: KV Control
components.role: manages dynamic KV-cache allocation within the core's memory

components.name: Addr. Gen.
components.role: address generation logic for accessing crossbar memory

components.name: Pipe. Control
components.role: pipeline control logic coordinating token-grained pipelining within the core

components.name: Input buffer
components.role: 128KB ping-pong buffer storing 8-bit intermediate activations entering the core

components.name: Crossbar (XB) Array
components.role: 32-crossbar array with 4MB SRAM capacity performing the core's MAC computation

components.name: XB
components.role: one of the 32 individual crossbar units interconnected via a 1024-bit H-tree NoC

components.name: ElementWise
components.role: elementwise operations (exp, multiply, add) within the special function unit

components.name: Reduction
components.role: add-tree and sqrt reduction operations within the special function unit

components.name: Output buffer
components.role: 32KB buffer storing output intermediate activations from the core

flows.what: activation propagation across the wafer mesh (isomorphic dies)
core-to-core mesh link, replacing a defective core
partial results for elementwise nonlinear processing
intermediate values for reduction (add tree / sqrt)

content.key_idea: Ouroboros is organized hierarchically from a 215mm x 215mm wafer of stitched homogeneous dies, down to a 13x17 mesh of CIM cores per die, down to a single CIM core containing a 32-crossbar SRAM array, buffers, control unit and special function unit, so all LLM inference stays in first-level on-chip SRAM.
content.reading_order: Left to right, zooming in through three nested panels: (a) whole wafer with dies and inter-wafer interface, (b) one die's CIM core mesh with a faulty core being bypassed, (c) one CIM core's internal microarchitecture.

summary: This figure presents Ouroboros's three-level hierarchical architecture. Panel (a) shows the wafer-scale integration: a 215mm x 215mm monolithic wafer composed of 9x7 homogeneous dies stitched together via offset exposures, with an inter-wafer interface (optical Ethernet) for multi-wafer scaling and on-chip SRAM storing weights, activations and KV cache. Panel (b) zooms into a single die's organization: a 13x17 mesh of CIM cores with 256-bit bidirectional core-to-core links in all four directions, illustrating core-level fault tolerance by marking a defective core with a red X being bypassed. Panel (c) further zooms into a single CIM core's microarchitecture: input/output buffers, a 32-crossbar array with 4MB SRAM linked by a 1024-bit H-tree NoC, and a control unit (sync register, KV control, address generation, pipeline control) alongside a special function unit for elementwise and reduction operations.
summary_zh: 该图展示Ouroboros的三级层次架构：(a)215mm×215mm晶圆级集成，由9×7同构裸片拼接而成，支持多晶圆光互联扩展；(b)单裸片内13×17网格CIM核心的高带宽网状互联，图中红叉标出容错替换的失效核心；(c)单个CIM核心微架构，含32路Crossbar阵列、输入输出缓冲区及控制单元。
